decisions: JAYA_MASTER_AUTONOMOUS_DEV_GUIDE_v3.md is the highest-authority specification; the v1.0 guide is subordinate compatible detail.
Begin as a bounded modular monolith, preserving module-owned data and public API/event contracts.
No implementation capability may be marked complete without repository evidence and applicable test results.
DOC-001 planning baseline is accepted; FND-001 is the first implementation task.
FND-001 will be delivered as separately reviewable subtasks, beginning with the local executable toolchain before CI and boundary enforcement.
The exact .nvmrc value is the pinned development runtime, while engines.node may remain a compatible supported-runtime range; packageManager must identify an exact npm version.
concerns: There is no CI, database, authentication, deployment, or monitoring foundation yet.
The eventual production/staging environments and external provider credentials may require later human or cloud-access escalation, but do not block local foundation work.
The baseline requirement count is extensive and must remain mechanically verifiable as statuses change.
FND-001 boundary checks must inspect real source paths and have persistent negative fixtures; checks that merely pass an empty repository are not acceptable.
GitHub currently reports no checks, so CI workflow execution evidence will be required before P0-09 can be accepted.
The current package.json does not exactly pin npm and therefore does not yet satisfy the requested pinned package-manager toolchain.

CURRENT_IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md contains some stale baseline wording inside the FND-001 task description, including a current-state row saying no manifest or tests exist; this should be reconciled in a later status-document review if not corrected with the current evidence update.
last_instruction: Correct FND-001a's reproducibility contract only: declare the exact npm version actually used via package.json packageManager, add automated assertions that the exact .nvmrc runtime satisfies engines.node and that packageManager is an exact npm version compatible with engines.npm, update the status evidence to distinguish the pinned development runtime/package manager from the supported runtime ranges, then rerun npm ci and the full verification chain from deleted node_modules and dist; commit the correction without starting FND-001b or marking FND-001 complete.
